snippet.title: ChivalBee and the Mycelium Menace | Official Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Buzzby Bumbleton has arrived!

Join Buzzby on his adventure to save the kingdom of Hivesdale from the Mycelium Menace!

ChivalBee is an action platform game with its roots set in deep by many of the industry's best. It answers the question of, "what if the double jump kick from Symphony of the Night was the main attack?" and combines it with the non-linear game design of MegaMan to create a unique adventure with deceptively creative gameplay! 

In this Alpha gameplay reveal, Buzzby shows off his drill attack, uppercut, and bouncing.
Backgrounds and more elements are still in the works, as this is a very early build of the game.

ChivalBee is the first game from Ophidian Interactive, a studio run by Dave Klein and Alan Baker.
